question: In what way is the fire named by Vājapeya and other rites devoted to Vedic duty?
premises: The figure is fire named by Vājapeya and other rites
The figure is devoted to Vedic duty
inference: The sacrificial fire identified with Vājapeya and other rites is wholly devoted to Vedic duty
plain_english: He is the fire named by the Vājapeya and other rites, devoted to the duties of the Veda.
